create_continuous_action_observer: create a ContinuousActionObserver instance to track statistics of continuous actions taken by an agent
observe_first_initial_state: call observe_first on ContinuousActionObserver to initialize action tracking for a new episode
observe_environment_step: call observe on ContinuousActionObserver to record one environment step with its action
get_metrics_episode_stats: call get_metrics on ContinuousActionObserver to retrieve per-dimension action max, min, mean, and p50 statistics
review_continuous_action_observer_class: review the ContinuousActionObserver class that extends EnvLoopObserver to track continuous action statistics per episode
